about: Raderna i "Blades was updated"-popupen: en post per EAS Update, nyast först, id +1 varje gång. Bara den uppdateringens egna ändringar, på engelska, med New:, Improved: eller Fixed: som App Store-texten och det viktigaste först. Se services/updateNotes.ts och scripts/publish-update.mjs.

notes: Fixed: Scanning never accepts a time that doesn't exist, like 07:80, and suggests real times instead.
Fixed: The maps no longer stop responding after you open an airport's weather.
Fixed: The globe on the dashboard comes back by itself if it stops moving.
Improved: This message now only shows what's new since your last update.
